goals.1: Pfand: get money back for returning bottles
dialog.1.de.8.n: Pfand: usually 25 cents per disposable (plastic) bottle
grammar.0.title: Bin colours in Germany
grammar.0.note: Colours and rules differ a little from city to city — check the notice from your landlord or the Hausverwaltung. Return Pfandflaschen (marked with a Pfand sign) at the supermarket.
grammar.1.title: Verbs for stating rules
grammar.1.note: man = people in general (subject). The modal verb is in second place, the infinitive at the end. nicht dürfen = forbidden; nicht müssen = don't have to (a different meaning).
grammar.2.text: „Ich kaufe weniger Plastik.“ = I buy less plastic. „Ich spare mehr Energie.“ = I save more energy. viel – mehr – am meisten · wenig – weniger – am wenigsten.
